data_description.scan_interval: How often the server is polled. Activity is detected with this precision.
data_description.activity_window: How long a model counts as active after a detected request. Must not be shorter than the polling interval.
data_description.check_updates: Adds an update entity that compares the server version with the latest release on GitHub (checked every 6 hours).
data_description.allow_management: Allows the pull model and delete model actions. Leave off unless you want automations to download or delete models.

error.activity_window_too_short: The activity window must be at least as long as the polling interval.

server_unreachable.description: Home Assistant has not been able to reach the Ollama server at {url} for more than 5 minutes. Check that the server (or its container) is running and reachable from Home Assistant. If the URL changed, use **Reconfigure** on the integration entry. This issue disappears once the server answers again.
